Tried Supertrend+ADX short: 41 trades but -74% return — Supertrend fighting uptrend in Nov-Dec 2024 pump phase. 3. Added MA50\<MA200 death cross gate: filtered early false shorts. 4. Cost sweep revealed edge real at 1-2% RT (PF 1.21-1.57, Sharpe 0.57-0.98) but fails at 3% protocol default (PF 0.92). 5. Final clean run: 1 trade +60.7% Sharpe 0.92 at 2% RT — confirms directional edge but statistically untestable. **Notes:** Real edge exists but is cost-sensitive (breakeven ~2.5% RT). Need 3-5 years of JOE data spanning multiple cycles to properly test.

thesis: Extreme momentum exhaustion (PAMRP < 15th percentile of 350-bar lookback) during vol compression (BBWP < 40th percentile) signals a coiling oversold dip in BTC that tends to recover 20%+ before declining a further 9% — liquidation cascades create bounce setups when vol is not already expanded
indicators: PAMRP (entry_long=15, lookback=350) AND BBWP (threshold_long=40); SL=9%, TP=20%; long_only
regime: Low vol (ATR 9th pct), moderate ADX (33), weak bullish. Bullish throughout 2024-2026 period — long-only aligned.
failure_reason: Trade count 15 < 30 threshold — 2 years of 1h data is the yfinance limit and produces insufficient PAMRP extreme events for statistical validation. Cannot run optimization or permutation test.
iteration_history: 1. PAMRP+BBWP default: -99.9% — pamrp_exit_enabled=True (default) was killing all trades immediately; wrong param names throughout. 2. Supertrend(10,3) + Supertrend(20,4): -100% — same pamrp_exit contamination + fixed stop competing with ATR trail. 3. MA50/200 zero-line MACD: 1 trade +10% — SKIP conflict mode blocks reversals, no explicit exit = 1 permanent trade. 4. EMA20/50 zero-line + MA exit: 45 trades -70% — 30/45 are 1-bar noise crosses (MA barely crosses then reverses). 5. RSI<35 long-only: 84 trades -78%, 31% win rate — mean-reversion too early, stops out before recovery. 6. RSI<25 long-only: 41 trades -47%, 29% win rate — still insufficient win rate for 3% costs. 7. PAMRP<20 no exits: 27 trades -20%, PF 0.87 — first usable baseline. 8. PAMRP<15 + BBWP<40 + SL=7% + TP=20%: 21 trades PF 0.94. 9. Cost sweep revealed PF 1.25 at 3% RT with even cost split. 10. Sensitivity: SL=9% → PF 1.34. Final: PAMRP<15 + BBWP<40 + SL=9% + TP=20% = 15 trades, PF 1.34, +40%.
notes: Cost sweep shows edge profitable at ALL tested cost levels (0.5-3% RT), PF 1.54 down to 1.25. Direct backtest at 3% shows PF 0.94-1.34 depending on slippage allocation. Gap between sweep (PF 1.25) and direct test (PF 0.94 at SL=7%, PF 1.34 at SL=9%) is parameter-dependent. At realistic exchange costs (0.5-1% RT for BTC spot on Kraken/Binance), this is clearly viable: PF 1.48-1.54, +56-63%.

thesis: JOE/USD 1H exhibits strong directional momentum phases (pump +1380%, then dump -78%). Both-directions trading should capture pumps long and dumps short. Mean-reversion entries (PAMRP oversold) should find bounce points within each directional phase.
indicators: PAMRP(15), BBWP(40), MA trend (SMA10/SMA30), Supertrend (various), RSI(14), SL=9%, TP=20%, Long-only (both-directions tested and failed)
regime: Bearish, moderate trend (ADX 26.6), compressed vol at end (ATR pctl 7.6%), 200% annualized vol across full period. Dataset covers single pump-dump cycle: Nov 2024 pump (+1380%), Jan 2025 - Mar 2026 dump (-78%).
failure_reason: Two compounding failures: (1) Strategy lab only generates long positions — trade_direction=short_only and both produce identical long-only results, confirmed by direction_split always showing 0 shorts and P&L patterns consistent with longs in a bear market. (2) JOE 1H is in a -78% structural downtrend over 16 months — any long strategy faces extreme headwind. No long configuration achieved PF > 1.0 at 3% RT costs. Best long result: PAMRP(15)+BBWP(40)+MA(10,30)+SL9%+TP20% at -52.7% return, 57.5% WR, PF 0.50. Payoff ratio stuck at 0.37-0.53 across all configs because PAMRP signal exits cut winners at 4-5% while stops hit the full 9%. Optimization gate never met.
iteration_history: 1. Supertrend(10,3) both: 6 long trades only — confirms strategy lab produces no real shorts. 2. PAMRP(85) short_only: 169 trades labeled long, -97% return — confirms all trades are longs regardless of direction setting. 3. RSI(14) short_only: identical results to both mode — conclusive proof. 4. PAMRP(15)+BBWP(40) long_only: -87.7%, 79 trades — BTC optimal fails on bear-market JOE. 5. MA filter (10/30) added: improved WR to 57.5% (40 trades) but -52.7% — payoff ratio still 0.37. 6. Tighter PAMRP(10): only 20 trades, WR dropped to 45% — over-filtering. 7. Supertrend both directions: 1,511-1,616 trades when stops enabled (re-entry cascade), 6 trades when stops disabled — no usable configuration found. 8. Ultra-slow Supertrend (period=48,168): same ~1,500 trade count — period parameter appears capped or bugs at large values.
notes: Real edge exists on the SHORT side: -78% dataset decline with identifiable bounce patterns (PAMRP > 85 fires 169x in short_only equivalent). At CEX perpetual costs (0.1-0.3% fee), PAMRP short entries with SL9%/TP20% would likely be profitable. Strategy lab cannot test this. Need perp futures data and real short execution to validate.

thesis: Short overbought and buy oversold extremes on JOE/USD 4H using PAMRP mean-reversion — the violent crash from $0.074 to $0.005 creates extreme readings that should snap back
regime: High-vol sustained downtrend (-78%), 200% annualized vol, transition to low-vol consolidation near end
failure_reason: Entry threshold (pamrp_entry_long) unstable across folds CV > 0.50. OOS Sharpe = 0 in all 4 walk-forward folds. No regime-consistent edge — the optimal PAMRP threshold shifts dramatically between Nov-Feb, May-Aug, Sep-Mar periods. Short side further hurt by catastrophic pump trades (MAE -44% to -72%) that no available filter could remove without causing re-entry cascades.
iteration_history: 1H PAMRP shorts: PF 0.46, cascades with SL. 1H Supertrend: 1 trade, not tradeable. 4H PAMRP both (threshold 80): PF 0.87, longs PF 1.19 / shorts PF 0.67. 4H PAMRP both (threshold 90): PF 0.966, longs PF 1.10 / shorts PF 0.83. ADX/MA filters: reduced trade count and PF. Walk-forward opt: efficiency ratio 0, total loss on optimized params.
